name: Real-time Voxel Editing with Section Rebuild
definition: Updating the mesh immediately when a voxel is placed or removed by regenerating the mesh data for the affected section and any adjacent sections if the edit is on a boundary.
summary: Real-time Voxel Editing with Section Rebuild enables immediate visual feedback by regenerating mesh data only for affected 16x16x16 sections, differing from full-chunk rebuilds by limiting computation to the minimal set of intersecting sections.
